scripts.setup: node scripts/verify-node-version.mjs && npm.cmd ci && uv --directory python sync --locked
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md .prettierrc.json eslint.config.js scripts apps/web && uv --directory python run --locked ruff format --check
scripts.format:write: prettier --write package.json README.md CONTRIBUTING.md .prettierrc.json eslint.config.js scripts apps/web && uv --directory python run --locked ruff format
scripts.lint: eslint . && uv --directory python run --locked ruff check
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --fix && uv --directory python run --locked ruff check --fix
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && uv --directory python run --locked mypy src
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts && uv --directory python run --locked pytest -m unit
scripts.coverage: vitest run --coverage --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts && uv --directory python run --locked coverage run -m pytest && uv --directory python run --locked coverage report
scripts.check: npm.cmd run format:check && npm.cmd run lint && npm.cmd run typecheck && npm.cmd run test:unit && npm.cmd run build && npm.cmd run test:integration && npm.cmd run smoke
